value.rationale: A complete, exactly factorized spectrum over all core and peripheral sizes is a natural structural quantum-transport invariant for a fully-connected core with a sparse periphery. The extensive flat band produces an all-time protected weight independently of core size. This meaning is stronger than isolated finite diagonalization or the previously known one-hub collision-dark kernel.
